root_idea.summary: A root centered on constriction, dryness, and the inability to receive or produce an effect.
root_idea.development: The semantic range develops from dryness or constriction that blocks reception into barrenness, non-productivity, severity, obstruction, and figurative forms of restricted or unfruitful action.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Classical Arabic citation form عَقِيمٌ.

senses.definition: Barren; unable to receive or produce offspring.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran, applied to a woman or to the reproductive capacity associated with women, including the woman described as an old woman and the women referred to collectively.

senses.definition: Non-fecundating and therefore unproductive or destructive, especially of a wind that brings neither rain nor fruitfulness.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran, applied to the wind sent against ʿĀd; the construction concerns failure to fertilize clouds or trees and consequent destruction.

senses.definition: A day deprived of its expected fruit or joy; specifically, the Resurrection Day understood as having no ordinary day after it.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran, applied to a day. The transmitted explanations emphasize either the absence of joy or the fact that no day follows the Resurrection Day.

other_classical_meanings.definition: His joints became dry, bound, and impacted so that the backbone was as one vertebra.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of bodily joints, including in an account of people unable to prostrate themselves.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become bad or evil in disposition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use applied to a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become silent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative verbal use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a womb barren or incapable of receiving offspring.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative transitive use, including the construction in which God is said to have made a womb barren.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To sever communion, kinship, and kindness between people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Figuratively said of a false oath and its effect on social ties.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To silence someone or a group.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II causative/intensive usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To contend, dispute, litigate, or vie with someone for superiority.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form III reciprocal or confrontational usage, including striving to surpass another in strength or power.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In a poetic expression, to dig hollows in the sides of a water source; another interpretation is to go to and fro.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The two interpretations are reported for the same poetic usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Coming to water by turns or time after time.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal noun synonymous with coming successively or alternately.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Testing a well by digging a small shaft in it near the water to determine whether the water is sweet before completing the excavation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized well-digging technique.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Entering into or embarking upon an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Figurative usage of the same verbal noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Overcoming another in a game of hazard.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized gaming usage, synonymous with gambling victory.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A red garment or a variegated, figured cloth, including a cloth used as a covering for a camel-vehicle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sources report several closely related textile applications, including a particular red garment and figured cloth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dryness that prevents the reception of an impression or effect.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Presented as the primary nominal signification; it is also used for barrenness of the womb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The return or recurrence of the moon.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man of old or hereditary nobility and generosity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A social and character description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Obscure, recondite, archaic, or difficult-to-understand speech or language.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to expressions whose mode or vocabulary is unknown, obsolete, or no longer ordinarily used.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A vehement war or battle in which there is much slaughter and no one pauses or waits for another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension describing an especially relentless conflict.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person of evil disposition; by extension, a woman of evil disposition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative nominal use distinct from the verbal description of becoming bad-tempered.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An incurable disease, or one from which recovery is not expected.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic pathological use; related variant forms are reported in the lexical tradition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A strong, mature she-camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized zoological or descriptive use, especially of a camel in an advanced age class.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A species of fish; according to another report, a sea serpent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sources preserve both identifications for the marine creature.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A hard, distressing, or distressful day lacking joy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative description of a severe day, distinct from the Quranic adjective’s attested day construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man to whom no child is born.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical Arabic extension of the childlessness term to a male person; the Quranic occurrences in this artifact concern other constructions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Barren or unprofitable in effect, applied to an intellect that benefits its possessor nothing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use of the adjective with intellect as its subject.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Strange or difficult-to-understand words, expressions, or sentences.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative application to speech or language, with the speech described as barren or obscure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Without air or wind and consequently sultry or intensely hot, applied to a day.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative weather description distinct from the Quranic wind and Resurrection-Day constructions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The present world that yields no good to its people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic figurative expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dominion in which kinship and friendship afford no protection and ties of relationship are severed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiom referring to the ruthless pursuit or exercise of power, including violence among relatives.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A joint or knot, especially a joint of a horse or a joint in straw.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Of a horse, it may refer to the pastern, knee, hock, or specified vertebrae; in straw, it denotes a joint or knot.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Reported as the same textile meaning as عَقْمٌ.

cautions: The day-related Quran interpretation is preserved without converting Lane's historical citation notation into a modern location; the example uses the supplied QAC occurrence at 22:55.
